summary: For this challenge, we developed a basic game called Astroblaster. This game require you to shoot as many meteors as possible in 60 seconds. Imagine in 2100s, when technology has developed drastically, we can just go to space and shoot these meteors with spacecraft. And this game do exactly that to simulate that scenario and training our future generation when that thing become a space mission.
details: Our project is a simple space-themed meteor shooting game where players control a spaceship to shoot and destroy incoming meteors while avoiding collisions and trying to achieve the highest possible score. The game features basic movement controls, shooting mechanics, meteor spawning, collision detection, and a scoring system, with increasing difficulty to create a more challenging experience. Our project aims to provide entertainment while helping players improve their reflexes, concentration, and hand-eye coordination. It also demonstrates our creativity, programming skills, and teamwork through the development of an interactive game. We used programming tools and game development technologies to create and test the game on a personal computer. The creative aspect of our project comes from combining a space-themed environment with classic shooting gameplay, making it simple to understand but still exciting to play. During development, our team considered gameplay mechanics, difficulty balance, visual design, performance, and user experience to ensure that the game is enjoyable, accessible, and runs smoothly on ordinary computers.
